statements.markdown: **Proposition 6.142.** *Every shared-prefix family just defined at depth $N$ contains a finite support $A$ with $|K_A(N)|\le B(N)$, and at a feedback row this survives *both* outputs of the corpus’s total feedback theorem; full-cylinder advance or a localized one-hole seam, which can delete at most one of carries $3,4$.*
